source_document_boundary_statement: This PROG-378 manifest is a Legal Finality Conformance Binding Draft. It binds evidence boundaries only. It does not create legal validity, legal certification, customer acceptance, customer readiness, production readiness, operational readiness, OPC ALLOW, Matrix effective state mutation, deployment, runtime deletion, runtime destruction, data destruction, or data erasure. It inherits PROG-377 Closure Conformance as parent evidence without converting closure into legal finality. It acknowledges PROG-371 Retention Conformance as already existing and does not recreate retention.
